traits: Defines his managerial role as a beloved friend and protective patriarch, conflating the workplace with a surrogate family and viewing subordinates as his children.
Views himself primarily as an entertainer and comedic performer, treating everyday workplace duties and leadership as a stage to elicit laughter, applause, and affection.
Dramatizes mundane workplace responsibilities, interpersonal conflicts, and personal hardships into high-stakes, cinematic spectacles.
Craves social belonging and affirmation, presuming uninvited inclusion and deep intimacy while inserting himself into others' private lives and conversations.
Disregards interpersonal and professional boundaries through crude humor, demographic stereotypes, juvenile pranks, and compulsive oversharing of intimate personal details.
Inflates his competence and status with grandiose self-flattery, reflexively deflecting accountability and reinterpreting failures or criticism to preserve his self-image.
Idealizes romantic relationships through childlike, melodramatic fantasies, prematurely declaring intense devotion and rushing into major commitments.
Equates personal affection and respect with monetary expenditure, relying on conspicuous spending and lavish gifts to win admiration.
speech_acts: Tone: Adopts an energetic, boisterous master-of-ceremonies delivery, hyping up colleagues and treating ordinary workplace gatherings like grand stage performances.; Inflates mundane administrative tasks, routine policies, and casual events with grandiose, self-important, and melodramatic seriousness.; Shifts abruptly between extreme registers, swinging rapidly from breathless excitement or performative cheer to pleading earnestness, sharp rebukes, or theatrical distress.; Adopts a didactic, self-righteous, and patronizing instructional tone when imparting basic concepts or moralizing to a group.; Delivers shocking, hostile, or petty admissions in a casual, matter-of-fact deadpan.; Retreats into flat, theatrical sarcasm, sulking self-pity, or ominous coldness when challenged or feeling unappreciated.; Speaks with overly familiar, breezy informality and playful intimacy regardless of professional boundaries or hierarchical distance.

Vocabulary: Reaches for elevated, legalistic, or pseudo-intellectual vocabulary and corporate buzzwords to project authority or gravitas.; Adopts dated colloquial slang, playful abbreviations, and pop-culture catchphrases in an attempt to sound youthful and culturally current.; Introduces childish diminutives, clumsy malapropisms, and inappropriately crude or sexual terms into ordinary workplace discussions.
Poses a rhetorical question to an audience or to himself and immediately provides his own direct answer.
Chains short, repetitive declarative fragments, parallel clauses, or repeated imperatives in rapid succession to build momentum or force agreement.
States a high-minded principle, philosophical maxim, or grand compliment only to immediately contradict, undercut, or deflate it with a crude or mundane reality.
Spirals into tangled, backtracking clarifications and over-qualifying disclaimers when trying to navigate an awkward statement or recover ground.
Structures arguments or evaluations as rigid, enumerated lists, explicit pro-and-con breakdowns, or chronological phases.
Constructs pseudo-logical maxims, circular idioms, or inverted aphorisms to give personal opinions the appearance of timeless wisdom.
Mangles idioms, proverbs, and professional terminology through malapropisms, conflated expressions, and literal misinterpretations.
Slips unprompted into exaggerated character voices, celebrity impressions, pop-culture quotes, and spontaneous bursts of song.
Vocalizes drumrolls, scat singing, elongated vowels, buzzer noises, and rhythmic chants to illustrate points or manufacture excitement.
Coins playful portmanteaus, childish slang terms, and juvenile diminutive phrasing in place of standard vocabulary.
Riffs on colleagues' names through rhythmic chanting, rhyming variations, associative wordplay, and playful invented suffixes.
Repeats short affirmations, negations, or clarifying phrases in rapid succession when flustered, defensive, or composing himself.
Delegates uncomfortable managerial duties, domestic chores, and boundary-crossing personal errands to subordinates to avoid conflict or manage his private life.
Launches into unprompted comedic impressions, character roleplays, and theatrical physical stunts to entertain coworkers and dominate attention.
Deflects professional scrutiny, reprimands, and blunders by fabricating excuses, shifting blame onto others, or reframing mistakes as morale-boosting lessons.
Probes into colleagues' personal and romantic lives while offering unsolicited, boundary-crossing commentary and advice on their relationships and physical appearances.
Dispenses garbled business axioms, pop-culture comparisons, and pseudo-philosophical life rules with total self-seriousness to position himself as a wise mentor.
Solicits validation and praise from subordinates, forces his inclusion into their social circles, and promises lavish gifts or surprises to buy immediate approval.
Shuts down dissenting colleagues and awkward interactions with sharp commands, juvenile insults, and assertions of managerial rank.
Publicly airs confidential personnel grievances and exposes colleagues' private matters to the assembled group under the guise of mediation or education.
Fabricates false scenarios, loyalty tests, and manipulative ruses to test colleagues or cover up his own blunders.
